title: Materi — perpustakaan materi komunitas + permalink materi
description: The Materi tab (DECISIONS #36/#37): teaching material is TENANT-level content with its own canonical, shareable URL /k/<tenant>/materi/<lessonSlug>, and a course is just one ordered arrangement of it. Two surfaces — the LIBRARY (member-gated, cursor-paginated, tag-filtered, iOS inset grouped list, client-side text narrowing over loaded pages) and the MATERI PAGE (server-rendered etalase header + generateMetadata + its own opengraph-image from publicGetBySlug; the BODY is member-gated and renders through MarkdownView from @/features/courses, never a second parser). Below the body: the tag row (each tag links back to the library opened on that tag) and 'Muncul di kelas' from backlinksFor — the same materi in every course that teaches it, plus the materi→materi graph. A draft materi is NOT_FOUND for a member and readable for instructor+; a draft COURSE never hides its materi. The frontend only READS: materi writes live in the Kelola console (features/courses lessons.*) and tags in features/materi/tags.

peers.reason: MarkdownView + YoutubeEmbed + LessonLinks — the app's one safe-subset markdown/embed pair; the in-course reader renders the same materi through the same components
useMyMembership drives the member gate on both surfaces

app-shell: /k/[slug]/materi/[lessonSlug] ← server etalase header + generateMetadata + opengraph-image (publicGetBySlug) + <MateriDetailView tenantId tenantSlug lessonSlug hasServerHeading gate />
